result.line: Across fast-fill builder EOA: ~1784 tx/day (nonce delta 12488/50400 blocks), all calling its own gated ProposerMulticall 0x9ccc2f3e.multicall 0x1bc74526 (reverts unless msg.sender==BUILDER) -> proposer 0x394311a6.onCall -> SpokePool.fillRelay; ledger slice 8103 fills / 2.2d (~3650/day, ~2/tx), sample fill 0.3744 WETH=$680 spread $0.39; the EOA receives $0 in-transaction (value 0, no transfer) and pays $0.046 gas/call (~$82/day, ETH $1817.75 coins.llama.fi); repayment goes to the proposer contract later, so a fresh caller of this contract gets nothing.
